spec.title: Any Queries
spec.description: The status code doesn't matter; all queries are displayed.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /^${measurementquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Domain"] =~ /^${domainquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Domain"] !~ /^${domainquery_exclude:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Ip"] =~ /^${ipquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Ip"] !~ /^${ipquery_exclude:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Statuscode"] =~ /^${statuscodequery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Agent"] =~ /^${agentquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uri")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with full: r.Domain + " → " + r._value }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with fulluri: r.Scheme + "://" + r.Domain + r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["full", "Statuscode","Ip", "fulluri"])
  |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "total"})
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with open: "Open" }))
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> yield(name: "alias")

spec.title: Any Queries Except Status [200, 401, 403, 404, 499, 500]
spec.description: Show all queries where the status code is not 200, 404, 499 and 500.

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /^${measurementquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Domain"] =~ /^${domainquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Domain"] !~ /^${domainquery_exclude:regex}$/)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Agent"] =~ /^${agentquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.Statuscode != "200" and r.Statuscode != "401" and r.Statuscode != "403" and r.Statuscode != "404" and r.Statuscode != "499" and r.Statuscode != "500")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uri")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /^${measurementquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Domain"] =~ /^${domainquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Domain"] !~ /^${domainquery_exclude:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Ip"] =~ /^${ipquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Ip"] !~ /^${ipquery_exclude:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["Agent"] =~ /^${agentquery:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.Statuscode == "500")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uri")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with full: r.Domain + " → " + r._value }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with fulluri: r.Scheme + "://" + r.Domain + r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["full", "Ip", "fulluri"])
  |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "total"})
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with open: "Open" }))
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> yield(name: "alias")
